item.text: {"action":"batch","arguments_json":"{\"calls\":[{\"action\":\"run\",\"arguments\":{\"command\":[\"python\",\"-c\",\"from work import evaluate\\np={'defaults':{'b':True,'i':3,'s':'x'},'types':{'b':'boolean','i':'integer','s':'string'},'null_resets':True,'environment':True}\\ncases=[\\n ({'layers':[{'b':False,'i':0,'s':''}]},{'ok':True,'config':{'b':False,'i':0,'s':''},'error':None}),\\n ({'layers':[{'i':None}]},{'ok':True,'config':{'b':True,'i':3,'s':'x'},'error':None}),\\n ({'layers':[{'i':'bad'},{'i':4}]},{'ok':True,'config':{'b':True,'i':4,'s':'x'},'error':None}),\\n ({'layers':[{'i':True}]},{'ok':False,'config':{},'error':'type'}),\\n ({'layers':[{'extra':1}]},{'ok':False,'config':{},'error':'unknown_key'}),\\n ({'environment':{'b':'false','i':'-12','s':''}},{'ok':True,'config':{'b':False,'i':-12,'s':''},'error':None}),\\n ({'environment':{'b':'False'}},{'ok':False,'config':{},'error':'environment'}),\\n ({'environment':{'i':' 1'}},{'ok':False,'config':{},'error':'environment'}),\\n ({'environment':{'i':'1.0'}},{'ok':False,'config':{},'error':'environment'}),\\n]\\nfor request, expected in cases:\\n actual=evaluate(request,p)\\n assert actual==expected,(request,actual,expected)\\np2=dict(p, null_resets=False, environment=False)\\nassert evaluate({'layers':[{'i':None}]},p2)=={'ok':False,'config':{},'error':'type'}\\nassert evaluate({'environment':{'i':'1'}},p2)=={'ok':False,'config':{},'error':'environment'}\\nprint('edge cases passed')\"]}},{\"action\":\"run\",\"arguments\":{\"command\":[\"python\",\"-c\",\"import json\\nfrom work import evaluate\\nwith open('policy.json') as f: p=json.load(f)\\nwith open('requests.json') as f: rs=json.load(f)\\nwith open('report.json') as f: report=json.load(f)\\nassert report == [evaluate(r,p) for r in rs]\\nprint('report verified')\"]}},{\"action\":\"run\",\"arguments\":{\"command\":[\"git\",\"diff\",\"--check\"]}},{\"action\":\"run\",\"arguments\":{\"command\":[\"git\",\"status\",\"--short\"]}}]}"}
